findings.claim: The 'v1 cleanup' facts line still names only 'Copilot CLI, VS Code and Codex v1 hooks call the global context-mode bin' as breaking after npm uninstall. The table two rows above it lists Gemini and Kiro with the identical hook pattern ('.hooks.* commands with context-mode' / '.hooks.* flat entries'), so they call the bin too and are left off the warning list.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0011-release-and-v1-transition.md v1 cleanup table: Gemini row 'Remove the entries...'; Kiro row 'Same rule as Claude Code'; both use hook commands containing `context-mode`. The facts line below only says 'Copilot CLI, VS Code and Codex v1 hooks call the global context-mode bin. After npm uninstall -g, these hooks fail until the cleanup runs.' This is the same gap flagged in r2 (dx-docs, out/r2/round1/review/dx-docs.json, finding 1, against the then ADR-0015 copy of this claim) and is still unfixed in ADR-0011, which now holds the canonical text.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY c56afc99 2026-03-05 'feat: global install + CLI hook dispatcher' (cm-main git log -S 'context-mode hook gemini-cli'). cm-main configs/gemini-cli/settings.json and configs/kiro/agent.json both invoke the bare `context-mode` binary via hook commands, same as Codex/Copilot/VS Code. ORIGINAL_INTENT (commit message): 'All platforms now use npm install -g context-mode as prerequisite'.
